name: fsp-dense-intake-single-turn
description: Settles the open reliability question in docs/plans/coach-chat-redesign-followups.md: does profile + goal + habits stated together in one single turn (not spread across turns the way fixture 12 does it) still fire correctly? Under the current schema (B3, #808) a stated goal and a new daily habit in the same message always move through season_start/season_start.new_habits together, never through standalone quest_create - quest_create is only for a habit stated with no season change at all. So the real question this fixture settles isn't 'quest_create vs nothing', it's whether piling profile facts into the same dense message as the goal/habit still lets season_start fire reliably, rather than the model judging (per B_engine.md's FSP step 4, 'quests get set up near the end') that intake isn't done yet and deferring. Coverage-audit phase 1, 2026-09-15.
